_evidence: 0x0054341c copies preset [0x831357] into the four option bytes 0x831377..0x83137a: 'mov esi,[0x831357]; shl esi,2; add esi,0x83135b', edi = 0x831377, ecx = 4, then 'mov al,[esi]; cmp al,0xff; je' (0xff = keep the current byte) / 'mov [edi],al' / 'loop'. The index is the preset number the game stores: 0x543442 writes 0..6 (match among the six dwords 0x83135b.., else 6) and 0x543ca5 shows it as text 0x4e4 + index (the 0x66b070 option descriptor edits the same dword); a fuzzed u32 put esi outside the image (25/200 faults at 0x543435). Domain: 0..6 (bytes 0x83135b..0x831376, 7 four-byte rows), plus 7 (the row is the destination itself, an in-place copy) and 0x40000002/0xc0000005 whose 'shl esi,2' wraps to rows 2/5 (no fault, so the address arithmetic is tested modulo 2^32). The 28 row bytes are 0xff in about half the cases (skip) and otherwise small/sign-boundary values; the destination bytes are random so a skipped byte keeps a visible old value. Plain byte copies: every value is valid.
